Latency sleep / Reflex. Auto: Reflex only in D3D11 games that use it, with VK_NV_low_latency2 + dxvk-nvapi. True: DXVK's built-in latency reduction for every game (no effect with in-game/external limiters). False: disable both.
Latency-sleep heuristic tolerance in µs. Higher = more latency, maybe smoother pacing. No effect when VK_NV_low_latency2 is used.
Don't use VK_NV_low_latency2 (Reflex unavailable; latencySleep=True then uses the custom algorithm). Auto disables it for 32-bit games only.
Frame rate limit (0 = off). DXVK 3.x replacement for DXVK_FRAME_RATE.
Enforce stricter max frame latency (0 = app value, 1-16).
Override Vsync for D3D10/11/12: 0 = off, n = on (every n-th vblank), -1 = app.
Override Vsync for D3D9: 0 = off, n = on, -1 = app.
True: mailbox when in-game Vsync is off (no tearing). False: FIFO_RELAXED when Vsync is on (tears instead of stuttering below refresh).
Present-timing features (non-native refresh emulation, frame limiter). Default True; disable only for debugging.
Only expose display modes with this refresh rate (0 = off). Use with caution.
Auto: GPL + optimized pipelines in background. True: GPL only. False: off (more stutter). Debug option.
VK_EXT_descriptor_heap. Auto: known-good drivers only. True: force if supported.
VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer (descriptor heap takes precedence when both are on).
Pipeline compiler threads (0 = all cores). Lower it to cut compile-time CPU contention on high-core CPUs.
Report NVIDIA GPUs as AMD. Auto hides unless NVAPI is enabled in Proton — set False when you need DLSS/Reflex via dxvk-nvapi.
VK_NVX_* CUDA-interop extensions required for DLSS (default True on 64-bit NVIDIA).
Hide the iGPU when a dGPU exists. Prefer DXVK_FILTER_DEVICE_NAME if possible.
Override reported VRAM in MB (0 = off). Fixes texture streaming in games that mis-handle large VRAM. Not a hard cap.
Expose the HDR10 colour space (defaults to DXVK_HDR).
Force AF for all D3D11 samplers (0-16, -1 = app). Can break bilinear-dependent passes.
Force AF for all D3D9 samplers (0-16, -1 = app).
Add to the app's mip LOD bias (-2.0 .. 1.0). Negative = sharper + shimmer.
Clamp negative LOD bias to 0 (after samplerLodBias).
Legacy per-API D3D10/11 frame limiter (0 = off). Prefer dxvk.maxFrameRate, or MangoHud / Gamescope limiters, which pace better.
Legacy per-API D3D9 frame limiter (0 = off). Prefer dxvk.maxFrameRate or an external limiter.
Enforce stricter max frame latency for D3D9 (0 = app value).
Report AMD GPUs as NVIDIA GPUs (workaround for AMDAGS / AMD-specific code paths). Auto = only for known-affected games.
Report Intel GPUs as AMD GPUs (workaround for Intel-specific libraries such as XeSS). Auto = known-affected games; defaults to True for D3D8/9.
Report NVIDIA GPUs running on NVK (Mesa) as AMD GPUs. Irrelevant with the proprietary NVIDIA driver.
Report this PCI vendor ID (hex) instead of the real one. 10de = NVIDIA, 1002 = AMD, 8086 = Intel.
Report this PCI device ID (hex) instead of the real one.
Report this adapter description string instead of the real GPU name.
Override reported shared system memory in MB (0 = off). Companion of dxgi.maxDeviceMemory; not a hard cap.
Only expose Vulkan devices whose name contains this string. Config-file equivalent of DXVK_FILTER_DEVICE_NAME.
Unreal Engine 4 HDR workarounds for games not named *-Win64-Shipping.exe (avoids AMDAGS crashes in D3D11 on HDR systems).
Cap the D3D11 feature level a device can be created with (default 12_1). Raising it can unblock apps that fail device creation.
Cap the tessellation factor (8-64, 0 = off). Big win in tessellation-heavy games.
Relax UAV pipeline barriers (ignore WAW in compute, all UAV hazards in graphics). Can raise performance; may cause rendering glitches.
Like relaxedBarriers but only for graphics-shader UAVs (compute untouched).
Insert barriers after group-shared-memory writes in compute shaders. Workaround for games with missing GroupMemoryBarrier; costs performance.
Insert barriers after UAV writes in compute shaders. Workaround for missing UAV sync; costs performance.
Per-sample instead of per-pixel shading when MSAA is on. Cleaner image, big performance cost.
Per-sample shading when MSAA is on (D3D9). Cleaner image, big performance cost.
Force every texture to 1 sample and fix up resolves/shaders. Big FPS gain at the cost of no MSAA.
Don't map dynamic images directly. Fixes corruption in games that ignore the driver's row pitch.
Put dynamic resources with these bind flags in cached system memory for fast CPU readback (v=vertex, i=index, c=constant, r=shader resource ...). Buggy-app workaround.
Advertise native driver command-list support (default True). Turn off if a game misbehaves with deferred contexts.
Force-enable the D3D11 context lock (ID3D10Multithread). Race-condition debugging.
Add to the app's mip LOD bias for D3D9 samplers.
Clamp negative D3D9 LOD bias to 0 (after samplerLodBias).
x*0 floating-point quirk emulation. True = fast/less exact, Strict = slow/exact, False = off. Auto = per-game.
Stream shader constants into VRAM; may help GPU-bound scenes. Auto = discrete GPUs only.
Fast-path clears that nearly cover the whole render target.
Initial value (MB) for GetAvailableTextureMem tracking. Raise for old games that refuse to start with 'too little' video memory.
Only expose D3D9 display modes with this refresh rate (0 = off).
Always use seamless cube maps (prettier edges, deviates from real D3D9).
FP16 for partial-precision instructions. May help weak GPUs, can regress desktop GPUs.
Allocate write-only D3DPOOL_DEFAULT buffers in cached system memory (buggy-app readback fix).
Force the aspect ratio of exposed D3D9 display modes.
Cap the VRAM DXVK will use, in MB (0 = off). Debug only: severe slowdown when hit.
Zero mapped memory when suballocations are freed. Huge CPU cost; last resort for games that don't initialise their buffers.
Raw/structured buffer views via SSBOs. Auto = on where offset alignment is 4 B (AMD). Unsafe on hardware with stricter alignment.
Use VK_NV_raw_access_chains on NVIDIA (default True). Disabling reduces performance; debug only.
Resolve multisampled images when a game samples them as plain textures (fixes striped artifacts on NVIDIA). Default True.
Use VK_KHR_unified_image_layouts where available. Default True; debug only.
Free pipeline libraries aggressively to save memory/address space. Auto = 32-bit games only.
Custom sin/cos approximation. Auto = only on drivers with poor native precision.
Tiler (mobile GPU) submission heuristics. For perf testing only.
